running.label: Running
running.blurb: Foot speed and running economy, track to trail.

swimming.label: Swim / Water
swimming.blurb: Open-water swimming, paddling and kayak work.

machine.label: Machines
machine.blurb: Row, bike, ski and echo — pure engine on a fixed implement.

endurance.label: Endurance
endurance.blurb: Long aerobic grinds, typically 20 minutes and beyond.

sprint.label: Sprint / Power
sprint.blurb: Short maximal efforts under two minutes.

weightlifting.label: Weightlifting
weightlifting.blurb: Barbell cycling and technical Olympic lifting.

gymnastics.label: Gymnastics
gymnastics.blurb: Bodyweight volume — pull-ups, muscle-ups, HSPU, midline.

strongman.label: Odd Object
strongman.blurb: Sandbags, yokes, sleds, worms and loaded carries.

skill.label: Skill / Coordination
skill.blurb: Pegboards, handstand walks, obstacles, precision work.

grip.label: Grip
grip.blurb: Sustained grip demand — ropes, bars, heavy holds and carries.

models.percentile: Field-normalised placing per event (winner 1.0, last 0.0), averaged.
models.official: CrossFit's own finishing position and points total for the season.
models.zscore: Standardised margin against the field on the raw score, clamped to ±3 SD.

methodology.hardwareScale: Title 10, non-title podium 3, non-podium top ten 1, event win 0.5.
methodology.percentileBasis: Each event is scored against the year's full starting field, not just the athletes still in it, so surviving a cut is never a penalty.
methodology.consensus: Mean of the three model ranks; ties broken by mean model score.

transplant.solo: One athlete swapped into that year's real field. Independent per athlete, so two who would both beat the actual field each show first.
transplant.headToHead: The whole cohort competing in that year at once, against the remainder of the real field. Exactly one athlete wins each year.
